_doc: Signed session adjudication for the 9 quarantine_owner codes proposed by scripts/kbli_filiera/oss_refresh_loop.py's 2026-09-22 run (cure_specs/oss_refresh_2026_09_22.json). ADOPT for all 9: OSS RBA 2025 ruang-lingkup is served under each code's own uuid, its payload identity checked (Kbli.id == uuid, every risk-row kode prefixed by the code), and its scope text describes the code's own activity with no scope text shared with any other code in the batch (sha-checked). scripts/kbli_filiera/apply_oss_refresh.py is the only sanctioned reader of this file: it refuses any quarantine_owner code not named here with decision == 'adopt_oss_2025', and refuses if record_sha256/oss_rows_sha256 no longer match the live record/spec.
adjudicated_by: session M5 (Opus 5 architect), owner mandate 2026-09-23: the sessions decide
basis: OSS RBA 2025 ruang-lingkup served under the code's own uuid (payload identity checked: Kbli.id == uuid, every risk-row kode prefixed by the code). The scope text describes the code's own activity. No scope text is shared with any other code in the batch (sha-checked). The quarantine disputed PP28-vintage rows, and OSS 2025 is the source the other 1,340 strong codes rest on. This is the precedent of 49213: per_skala restored, disputed block kept.
